subject: orchestrator-consensus-silent [medium]
body:
Orchestrator MCP API endpoint unreachable from overseer container; monitoring degraded to CLI-only

Detail:
All MCP calls to http://orchestrator.egg-system.svc.cluster.local:9849 are timing out (mcp__progress__query_status, mcp__brc__get_state, mcp__brc__list_blocking all fail). The overseer_monitor.py script reports pipeline_unreachable / config-unavailable. CLI (egg-orch) works via an alternate path. Pipeline IS running (implement/slice-1) — coder and tester containers are actively working as confirmed by container logs. No intervention needed on agents; this is an infrastructure monitoring-plane issue only.

Recommended action:
Verify orchestrator service health on port 9849. Check if there is a network policy or service mesh rule blocking overseer pod → orchestrator on this port. Overseer is falling back to CLI; monitoring continues but BRC/MCP tools will fail until resolved.

subject: slice-1 context-PR opener landed: tests need updating
body:
Slice-1 coder commit 3c0b1220c lands the new context-PR opener and deletes the 4 legacy `_maybe_open_base_pr_for_plan_to_implement` call sites in pipelines.py (slice_loop_entry, implement_entry_backstop, run_pipeline_autoadvance, hitl_resume). The legacy wrapper itself remains (slice-2 TASK-2-1 deletes it). One opener call site remains in phases.py:advance_phase (now wired to the new hard-required `_open_context_pr_at_implement_start`).

Pre-existing tests that will fail due to my deletions (NOT in my coder file boundary; need your update):

1. `orchestrator/tests/test_context_pr_transition_paths.py` — `TestCallSiteWiring::test_pipelines_py_has_expected_call_sites` expects 4 call sites in pipelines.py; got 0. `TestCallSiteWiring::test_phases_py_has_expected_call_site` expects the legacy wrapper still wired at phases.py; now uses the new opener. Action: rewrite both to assert (a) 0 legacy call sites in pipelines.py and (b) 1 new-opener call site (`_open_context_pr_at_implement_start`) in phases.py. Most other tests in this file directly mock `_maybe_open_base_pr_for_plan_to_implement` and continue to pass against the still-present function — those need conversion or deletion in slice-2 when the legacy wrapper itself is deleted.

2. `orchestrator/tests/test_slice_1_context_branch_base_resolution.py` — `TestSliceLoopEntryContextPRSafetyNet::test_wrapper_invoked_at_slice_loop_entry` and `test_wrapper_invoked_for_non_issue_keyed_pipeline` expect the wrapper call at slice-loop entry. That call site was deleted per cq-4 (the new opener is hard-required at phases.py:advance_phase, not defensively at slice-loop entry). Action: delete these two tests OR rewrite to assert that slice-1 base resolution goes through the new `_resolve_slice_base_branch` helper instead.

3. `orchestrator/tests/test_context_pr.py` — 3 failures: `TestOpenContextPRAdversarial::test_context_branch_name_is_egg_pipeline_id_context` and `test_qualified_pipeline_id_context_branch` import `_CONTEXT_BRANCH_RE` from `gateway.gateway` — that regex is deleted by slice-2 TASK-2-3; these tests should xfail until then OR be updated/deleted. `TestOpenContextPRCallSiteWiring::test_call_site_is_gated_on_plan_phase` expects the legacy wrapper at the auto-advance site (line 24129) — that call site is now deleted; rewrite or delete.

4. `orchestrator/tests/test_phase_transition_brc_history.py` — 2 tests fail with 422 because the test environment's pipeline-load path raises `[Errno 17] File exists` and the new opener (hard-required) surfaces it. These tests aren't about context PR — they exercise advance_phase's BRC-history persistence. Action: either (a) inject a mock for `_open_context_pr_at_implement_start` in the test setup, OR (b) construct a valid pipeline+contract fixture that the opener can load.

Also adds 3 new primitives that benefit from test coverage in TASK-3-8 (slice-3):
- `PlanPreflightError` + `validate_plan_preflight` in shared/egg_contracts/plan_parser.py (5 rejection cases)
- `_open_context_pr_at_implement_start` (happy + idempotent + hard-required-raises paths)
- `_is_slice_dag_mode`, `_resolve_slice_base_branch` (helpers)

Most other failures (test_cli.py, test_agent_salvage.py, test_gateway_client.py) are pre-existing network-timeout failures unrelated to my changes — verifiable by re-running on origin/slice-1 directly.

subject: agent-heartbeat-stall [medium]
body:
Coder and tester containers for slice-2 have been silent for 10+ minutes without heartbeating

Detail:
Slice-1 completed at ~04:19:52 UTC. New coder (e62f1286) and tester (3df0b864) containers started for slice-2 at ~04:20:27. It is now 04:30:07 — 9m40s without any coder or tester heartbeat in the message bus. The overseer_silent_agent_threshold_seconds is 600s. Five reviewers are stable in WAITING_FOR_EVENT loops awaiting CONSENSUS_PROPOSE from coder/tester. The documenter declared 'slice-2 has no doc tasks'. Possible explanations: (1) agents are silently loading a very long context from slice-1 history, (2) the new containers are stuck in initialization, (3) slice-2 may have no coder tasks (documenter declared empty). Recommend checking if slice-2 exists in the contract and whether coder has any assigned tasks.

Recommended action:
Check the contract for slice-2 task assignments. If coder has no slice-2 tasks, the system should auto-confirm. If coder has tasks, check container e62f1286 logs for initialization errors.

Detail:
Coder (351717d2) and tester (becfd4dc) containers for slice-2 started at 04:20:27 and have emitted ZERO heartbeats in 14 minutes. The overseer_silent_agent_threshold_seconds is 600s (10 min) — exceeded by 4+ minutes. Both roles have 0 tasks per get_assigned_tasks. The documenter also declared 'slice-2 has no doc tasks'. This suggests slice-2 may be an empty or minimal slice where agents should auto-confirm quickly — but they are not doing so. OVERSEER_ALERT sent at 04:30:39 woke the documenter (which was in a wait_loop) but had no effect on coder/tester (not in wait_loops — they are in LLM inference). Six reviewers (code, code_holistic, concurrency, security, contract, documenter) remain stable in WAITING_FOR_EVENT loops. The pipeline will not reach FAILED automatically; consensus-wrapper requires 3 failed restarts which have not occurred for these new containers. Human operator should verify container 351717d2 (coder) and becfd4dc (tester) are healthy and processing.

Recommended action:
Check logs for coder container 351717d2 and tester container becfd4dc. If LLM calls are stalled, consider restarting those specific containers. Verify that slice-2 has correct task assignments — if both have 0 tasks they should be auto-confirming quickly.

- test_merge_base_registers_session_when_no_bearer_token: assert register_session() is called with synthetic=True and the returned token is plumbed into the _make_request Authorization (or bearer_token kwarg)
- test_merge_base_skips_session_when_bearer_token_supplied: assert register_session() is NOT called and the supplied bearer_token is plumbed through

- test_merge_base_returns_sha_on_valid_stdout / test_merge_base_returns_none_on_returncode_1 / test_merge_base_returns_none_on_malformed_sha (already covered indirectly by _resolve_slice_base_branch unit tests but the gateway path itself is uncovered)

The pattern to mirror: orchestrator/tests/test_gateway_client.py already has tests for fetch_branch, ls_remote_branch, get_remote_branch_sha that all use the same session-bootstrap pattern — copy that shape.
